Masses are catalogue estimates. Prices are indicative USD (hobby market) and will vary by region and supplier. Weigh every part and update this file; the sizing page and docs are generated from it.

## Propulsion

| ID | Item | Qty | Mass (g, each) | Price ($, each) | On-board | Specification / notes |
|---|---|---:|---:|---:|:---:|---|
| P-01 | Brushless motor 2306, 1900-2300 KV | 1 | 33 | 22 | yes | 2306 outrunner, 4S rated, prop adapter, 16x16 or 12x12 mm mount pattern - Confirm static thrust on the thrust stand; vendor numbers are optimistic. |
| P-02 | Propeller 6x3.5 two-blade (spares) | 3 | 6 | 2 | no | 6 in two-blade, correct rotation for the motor, balanced - Always keep spares: the first crash breaks one. |
| P-03 | Propeller (mounted) | 1 | 6 | 0 | yes | see P-02 - Balance with a prop balancer or tape trim. |
| P-04 | ESC 40 A, 4S, DShot (BLHeli_S / AM32) | 1 | 10 | 25 | yes | Single-motor ESC, DShot300/600 - Set motor direction in the configurator before the first spin. |

## Power

| ID | Item | Qty | Mass (g, each) | Price ($, each) | On-board | Specification / notes |
|---|---|---:|---:|---:|:---:|---|
| E-01 | LiPo 4S 1300 mAh, 75C+, XT60 | 1 | 155 | 28 | yes | 14.8 V nominal, 16.8 V full - Buy 2-3 packs. Store at 3.8 V per cell. |
| E-02 | Servo BEC 6.0 V / 5 A | 1 | 12 | 9 | yes | Switching regulator, input 2S-6S, output 6.0 V >= 5 A peak - Four digital servos can pull 3-4 A together at stall. |
| E-03 | Logic BEC 5 V / 3 A | 1 | 6 | 6 | yes | Low-noise 5 V for Teensy, IMU, receiver - Separate from the servo rail to avoid brown-outs. |
| E-04 | Power leads, XT60 pair, 14 AWG silicone | 1 | 14 | 6 | yes | Battery lead to ESC with 1000 uF 35 V low-ESR cap - Solder carefully; this is the highest-current joint. |
| E-05 | Arming switch + remove-before-flight loop | 1 | 5 | 5 | yes | XT30 loop or anti-spark switch in the battery lead - Nothing powers up until the loop is inserted. |
| E-06 | Voltage/current sensor (INA226 breakout) | 1 | 2 | 4 | yes | I2C, 36 V, shunt rated >= 40 A, or use ESC telemetry - Needed for battery-low cut and power logging. |

## Avionics

| ID | Item | Qty | Mass (g, each) | Price ($, each) | On-board | Specification / notes |
|---|---|---:|---:|---:|:---:|---|
| A-01 | Teensy 4.1 (with microSD slot) | 1 | 4 | 32 | yes | 600 MHz Cortex-M7, 3 SPI, 3 I2C, 8 UART - Same MCU as the rocket: Phase 1 de-risks the software. |
| A-02 | IMU ICM-42688-P breakout | 1 | 2 | 15 | yes | 6-axis, SPI, gyro +-2000 dps, accel +-16 g - Mount on foam standoffs at the CG, away from the motor. |
| A-03 | Barometer BMP390 breakout | 1 | 1 | 8 | yes | I2C/SPI, +-0.5 m relative - Cover with open-cell foam against prop-wash noise. |
| A-04 | ExpressLRS 2.4 GHz receiver | 1 | 1 | 14 | yes | CRSF over UART, telemetry back-channel - Needs a matching ELRS transmitter module/radio (ground equipment). |
| A-05 | microSD card 8-32 GB, class 10 | 1 | 0.5 | 6 | yes | FAT32/exFAT, flight log at 500 Hz - Logs are how you tune. Never fly without logging. |
| A-06 | Carrier board / perfboard + headers | 1 | 8 | 5 | yes | 70x70 mm max, female headers for the Teensy - Replace with a custom PCB once the pinout is frozen. |
| A-07 | Buzzer + status LEDs | 1 | 2 | 3 | yes | 5 V active buzzer, 3x LED - Audible arming state and low-battery alarm. |
